description: Kimco Realty Operation LLC is the leading owner and operator of high-quality, open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the United States, with its executive officers engaged in the day-to-day management and operation of real estate exclusively with the company, with nearly all operating functions including leasing, asset management, maintenance, construction, legal, finance and accounting administered by the company, and its mission is to create destinations for everyday living that inspire a sense of community and deliver value to its many stakeholders. It began operations through its predecessor, The Kimco Corporation, which was organized in 1966 upon the contribution of several shopping center properties owned by its principal stockholders; in 1973 these principals formed the company as a Delaware corporation, in 1985 the operations of The Kimco Corporation were merged into the company, and it completed its initial public stock offering in November 1991. Its primary business objective is to be the premier owner and operator of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use assets in the U.S.
